mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in FEDFUNDS above 2% in the month preceding the prediction indicates the Fed is aggressively lowering policy rates, which lowers real discount rates and boosts equity present value, driving positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 2% in the prior month
regime_hint: Fed rate hike pause to easing transition
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative or flat despite FEDFUNDS > 2% for ≥3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Rising PAYEMS (labor market activity) coinciding with UNRATE below 6% suggests a tight labor market, which elevates wage growth expectations and supports equity valuations, producing positive 60-day S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases while UNRATE < 6% over the prior 2 months
regime_hint: Low unemployment with steady job growth
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative and PAYEMS growth outpaces UNRATE decline in regression.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in HOUST (residential construction) above 450K units in the prior month signals renewed building momentum, which is associated with long-term economic expansion and positive 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: HOUST remains flat for 4 consecutive months with no improvement in 20-day returns.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in INDPRO (industrial production) below 100 for two consecutive months indicates softening supply-side momentum, which can depress corporate earnings expectations and produce negative 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: INDPRO recovers sharply within 2 weeks with 20-day returns turning positive.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in CPIAUCSL (inflation index) below 205 over the prior month signals disinflation, lowering real risk-free rates and supporting equity valuations, leading to positive 5-day S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL crosses below 205 in the prior month
failure_condition: 5-day returns are negative despite CPIAUCSL < 205 for ≥2 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden spike in RSAFS (retail sales) above 350K while PAYEMS remains flat suggests resilient consumer demand without labor market strain, which can drive positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS crosses above 350K while PAYEMS remains unchanged for the prior month
failure_condition: 20-day returns are flat or negative despite persistent RSAFS growth.

mechanism_narrative: A prolonged decline in GDPC1 (GDP) above t-5 months with FEDFUNDS < 1% suggests a deepening economic slowdown, which typically precedes equity drawdowns and negative 60-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 60-day returns are positive or flat despite continued GDPC1 decline and FEDFUNDS near zero.

mechanism_narrative: UNRATE falls below 7% while PAYEMS accelerates, indicating a strengthening labor market and rising wage expectations, which can drive positive 20-day S&P 500 forward returns in expansionary regimes.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 7% and PAYEMS increases over the prior 2 months
failure_condition: 20-day returns are negative despite UNRATE < 7% and rising PAYEMS.
